title: gtm-cs 1:1 prep - Maya Singh & Ryan Cho (Q2 account planning)
content:
Goal for this 1:1:
- Align on top 6 accounts for Q2 upsell motions and identify high-risk churn signals to triage.
- Quick sync on Ryan's pipeline blocks and how CS <> AE handoff is tracking.
- Set clear action items and owners + deadlines.

Context / background:
- Ryan took over BookNook account in Jan; current NRR flat but new feature adoption low (only 12% DAU using embeddings-based search).
- AcmeCorp (enterprise) showing early signs of budget review; renewal in 90d. Exec engagement scheduled but CFO asking for unit economics.
- Small pilot customers: 2 integrations stuck on private deployment network reqs. Eng ticket open but ETA unclear.

Agenda (30 min):
1) Quick wins (5 min)
   - Any immediate blockers I can remove?
   - Ask Ryan if he needs an exec intro or SRE escalation.
2) Top accounts deep dive (15 min)
   - BookNook: adoption plan + webinar? (owner: Ryan)
   - AcmeCorp: pricing / E2E ROI ask (owner: Maya to prep CFO cost-breakdown)
   - OrionRetail: potential expansion to dedicated; need sizing doc from infra (action: Ryan ping infra contact)
3) Pipeline and handoffs (5 min)
   - Review AE <> CS play for closed-lost -> nurture list
4) Action items & next steps (5 min)

Notes to self / talking points:
- For BookNook: emphasize product-led adoption: propose 2-week concierge onboarding for embeddings search + highlight cost savings from batching/kv cache (reference: internal optimize playbook).
- For AcmeCorp: CFO will want per-ticket token cost + estimated monthly spend. Pull last 3 months usage and show trendline. If we can show 15% cost reduction with caching + quantized model, that helps.
- Ask Ryan who the internal champion is at AcmeCorp (name + title). If not Director+, need to escalate to AE for executive sponsor.
- Private deployment pilots: confirm whether network certs are the blocker or infra quota. If certs, propose solutions: temporary VPN, or pre-shared cert bundle from SRE (quick).

Risk signals to surface (be direct):
- Low feature adoption after >30 days post-rollout -> flag for potential churn play.
- Exec disengagement (no meeting scheduled in last 45 days) -> escalate to AE manager.
- Budget re-eval requests without product ROI ask completed -> at-risk.

Metrics to review (bring these):
- BookNook: DAU using search feature (current 12%), avg tokens per query, latency SLA breaches last 30d.
- AcmeCorp: MRR, avg token spend/mo, last 3 months usage trend, number of seats using private deploy.
- Pilot customers: number of blocked integration tickets, SLA to resolution.

Prep TODOs before the call (owner / ETA):
- Maya: export usage + cost delta comparisons for AcmeCorp (by EOD 3/14).
- Ryan: confirm internal champion names + calendar availability for Acme exec intro (by 3/14).
- Ryan: update BookNook onboarding checklist and flag top 3 blockers (by 3/14).
- Maya: open SRE short-ttl ticket template for private deploy certs and attach example cert bundle (by 3/14).

Action items expected after call:
- Ryan to schedule BookNook concierge onboarding (owner: Ryan; due: 3/22).
- Maya to send AcmeCorp one-pager + cost/ROI slide (owner: Maya; due: 3/18).
- Joint: set a 30-min exec intro call with AcmeCorp VP of Product (owner: Ryan to coordinate; due: 3/20).
- If pilot cert issue unresolved by 3/17 -> escalate to SRE manager (owner: Maya).

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Should we offer BookNook a temporary discount for concierge onboarding? Trade-off: short-term revenue vs adoption lift. Ask Ryan for conversion estimate.
- Do we involve Solutions Eng for AcmeCorp ROI modeling or can we produce in-house? (If SE needed, tag SE: @samir).

Quick wins I can do after this 1:1:
- Draft AcmeCorp cost slide and share for review.
- Send intro email template for exec intro (copy to Ryan).

Slack refs / links to bring:
- CONFLUENCE-ACCT-789 (AcmeCorp account notes)
- JIRA-CHURN-4321 (BookNook adoption follow-ups)
- #cs-private-deploy (for infra cert status)

Tone / reminders for the meeting:
- Be direct about risks but collaborative on next steps.
- Offer support/ops help to remove blockers quickly.
- Keep focus on adoption-first actions rather than pure discounting.

Post-meeting follow-up template (to copy into Slack/email):
- Subject: Recap + next steps — AcmeCorp / BookNook
- Quick bullet recap of decisions, owners, and due dates.
- Attach cost one-pager (Maya) and onboarding checklist (Ryan).
- Ask for confirmation on exec intro time slots.

-- end of notes --
